brand.name: Practical Poker Plus (PPP)
brand.tagline: The Ultimate Educational Poker Content & Replay Studio
brand.aesthetic: High-tech, modern, futuristic dark mode with neon lime green glowing accents, 3D hexagonal/honeycomb subtle grid patterns, and bold geometric all-caps typography.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

visual_enhancers.neon_border_glow: box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.25), inset 0 0 12px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.1); border: 1px solid #39FF14;
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: background: rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

layouts.nav_header: Fixed top bar with logo 'PRACTICAL POKER +' where '+' is highlighted in #39FF14, navigation links (Dashboard, Content Studio, PT4 Replayer, Coach Decks), active coach profile selector switcher, and Quick New Project CTA button.

content_studio.input_modal: Upload PPTX / DOCX or Paste Raw Lecture Text with AI Structure parser into modules.
layout_families: Title Slide (Massive Glowing Header + Chip Motif)
Section Header with Neon Bar Indicator
Bullet Points with Glowing Green Checkmarks
Ev & Pot Odds Stats Highlight Box
content_studio.layout_switcher: Toolbar on side/top allowing coaches to seamlessly cycle through layout families per slide.

pt4_animator.controls: Street Action Builder (Preflop, Flop, Turn, River), Pot Size tracker, Player Stacks & Hole Cards, Dealer Button, Scrub Timeline with Play/Pause/Rewind/Speed controls, and Export MP4/GIF render simulation.

motion.framer_transitions: Smooth scale on hover (hover:scale-[1.02]), neon glow pulses for active states, card dealing flips (rotateY), chip movement trajectories across the table canvas.

accessibility.contrast: All text elements maintain WCAG AA 4.5:1+ contrast against dark background (#0d0d0d) and felt background.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, dropdowns, timeline controls, and cards MUST feature explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace default splash screen in App.js with branded Practical Poker Plus application.
2. Implement Coach Login / Switching flow for the 4 PPP coaches (Alex Vance, Elena Rostova, Marcus Brody, David Chen).
3. Build Dashboard with project listings (Decks and PT4 Replays), quick search, filter by coach, and creation modals.

4. Build Content Studio: document upload / text paste with auto AI slide layout generation, 10-12 branded slide layout families, slide deck previewer, slide layout switcher, slide reordering/editing, and export simulation.

5. Build PT4 Poker Replay Animator: custom interactive oval table canvas with 2 to 9 player positions, hole card picker, board card street controls (Flop/Turn/River), action timeline recorder (Fold/Check/Call/Bet/Raise), scrub timeline with smooth play animation, and export dialog for GIF/MP4.
6. Apply dark theme (#0d0d0d) with neon green (#39FF14) accents, honeycomb grid overlay, and high contrast styling across all screens.
7. Ensure dropdowns and popovers have solid dark backgrounds (no raw standard transparent backgrounds).
8. Ensure every single interactive button, input, tab, card, and modal has appropriate data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default gradients.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or fixed headers.
Always apply hover micro-animations and explicit transition classes (avoid transition: all).
Maintain strict APCA/WCAG contrast using bright text against dark surfaces.
Ensure all interactive components have role-based data-testid attributes.
